profile.name: Pololu Maestro 多通道舵机控制器
profile.description: 这是一种可通过串口或 USB 控制的多通道舵机控制板，用于输出精确的 PWM/脉冲信号来驱动 RC 舵机及其他脉宽控制负载。在实验室和机器人、小车原型中，常用于转向机构、简单执行器以及灯光、制动等辅助通道控制。
profile.description_en: This is a multi-channel servo controller board that can be controlled over serial or USB to generate precise PWM/pulse signals for RC servos and other pulse-controlled loads. In labs and robotics or vehicle prototypes, it is commonly used for steering mechanisms, simple actuators, and auxiliary channels such as lights and brake-related outputs.
